simple.meaning: אָרַר (ʼârar) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to execrate.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 63 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 7 more, beginning at Genesis 3:14. Its contexts include family, blood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָרַר (H779).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אָרַר (ʼârar) / H779 is traced through Genesis 3:14, Genesis 3:17, Genesis 4:11, Genesis 5:29 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H779. arar [ אָרַר ] verb curse (Assyrian arâru Zim BP 68 ; on relation of meanings bind & curse in Assyrian see Dl Pr 101 ) — Qal Perfect אָרוֺתִיהָ וְאָרוֺתִ֫י, Mal 2:2 ; Imperfect 2masculine singular תָּאֹר Exod 22:27 ; Num 22:6 , 12 ; אָאֹר Gen 12:3 ; Imperative אָ֫רָהֿ Num 22:6 ; 23:7 ; אֹרוּ אוֺרוּ, & Infinitive absolute אָרוֺר all Judg 5:23 ; Participle אֹרֲרֵי Job 3:8 ; אֹרֲרֶיךָ Gen 27:29 ; Num 24:9 ; אָרוּר Gen 3:14 36t. etc.; — curse || בֵּרֵךְ bless , chiefly in poetic & legal sources of J E D & later imitations: 12:3 ; 27:29 (J) Num 22:6 , 12 ; 23:7 ; 24:9 (E) Exod 22:27 (E) Mal 2:2 ; ישְׁבֶיהָ אָרוֺר אֹרוּ = curse for ever her inhabitants Judg 5:23 ; יוֺם אֹרֲרֵי cursers of the day (magicians whose imprecations made days unlucky) Job 3:8 . Passive participle אָרוּר , chiefly as exclamation, || בָּרוּךְ Gen 3:14 , 17 ; 4:11 ; 9:25 ; 27:29 ; 49:7 ; Num 22:12 ; 24:9 (E, poetry) Deut 27:15-26 Judg 21:18 ; 1Sam 14:24 ; 14:28 ; 1 Samuel 26:29; Jer 11:3 ; 17:5 ; 20:14-15 , 48:10 (twice in verse); Mal 1:14 ; מִמִּצְוֺתֶיךָ הַשֹּׁגִים אֲרוּרִים cursed be those who wander from thy commands Psa 119:21 ( ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Jerome De Ri), הַזּאֹת הָאֲרוּרָה this cursed woman 2Kin 9:34 . Niph`al Participle נֵאָרִים cursed Mal 3:9 . Pi`el 3masculine singular suffix אֵרֲרָהּ curse, lay under a curse Gen 5:29 (J); Participle הַמְאָרֲרִים הַמַּיִם the curse-bringing waters Num 5:18-27 (P 6 t. waters destroying the perjured adulteress drinking them). Hoph`al Imperfect יוּאָ֑ר be cursed Num 22:6 (E).
